highlights.headline: Commission opens in-depth State aid investigation into arbitration award ordering Spain to pay compensation to JGC Holdings Corporation
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 04 Aug 2026 The European Commission has opened an in-depth investigation to assess whether an arbitration award ordering Spain to pay compensation to JGC Holdings Corporation (‘JGC') for changes to a renewable electricity support measure is in line with EU State aid rules.

highlights.headline: Is FOMO undermining climate diplomacy?
highlights.summary: The negotiating community has not become 20 times larger, but the COP has - and the rising number of participants, from politicians to business executives, is getting in the way of the task at hand The post Is FOMO undermining climate diplomacy? appeared first on Climate Home News.

highlights.headline: AI ecosystem's 'circular' investment: risk or advantage?
highlights.summary: Amid talk of an AI sector bubble, one aspect is under scrutiny. Many big AI players are invested in smaller ones, who then buy the bigger firm's products. This brings risks and advantages.
